Markus — quick legal pass attached (Redwood_Legal_Redline_MSAv2.pdf). Summary of material items: 

1) Ratecard / pricing: Acceptable. We can implement Aster's volume bands but propose a 12-month price protection clause and a floor price to prevent negative margin on very large usage spikes.

2) One-time onboarding credit: okay as a credit on the first invoice; suggest language that caps the credit to $X or percentage (we used 10% in the attachment).

3) Term extension: recommend we keep MSA term as-is and instead apply a limited extension on the order form (12 months for the new capacity layer) to avoid disturbing evergreen MSA notice windows.

4) Indemnity / Limits: Aster's tracked changes attempted to add carve-outs around open-source use and third-party integrations — we should push back. Proposed language keeps Redwood's standard limitation of liability and narrows carve-outs to explicit gross-negligence exceptions.

5) Termination for convenience: they requested shorter notice to terminate the added capacity layer. Recommend keeping standard 90-day notice for capacity deletions; offer a 60-day compromise for the pilot tranche only.

I've annotated the PDF with line-level comments and prepared a short addendum (see page 12) that amends Exhibit B and Exhibit E only. If you want, I can convert the addendum into a clean DocuSign packet for counter-signature.

Attached: Redwood_Legal_Redline_MSAv2.pdf (redline + addendum language)

--

- Implement the requested volume discount bands but include a 12-month price protection clause and a minimum floor price per token (see exhibit table).
- Apply the onboarding credit as a one-time invoice credit (capped at the equivalent of 10% of first-month charges).
- Keep data residency and SOC2 text unchanged.
- Compromise on termination notice for the pilot tranche: 60 days.

Next steps: Laura can convert this addendum into a DocuSign packet if the language looks good to you. If you agree, I will send the DocuSign link today and we can target signature by EOD Fri 11/05 to hit your internal board timeline.
